scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run fastapi dev src/api/main.py
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.format: npm run format:web && npm run format:api
scripts.format:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff format .
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.typecheck:api: cd apps/api && uv run mypy src
scripts.test:api:e2e: cd apps/api && uv run pytest -k e2e
scripts.test:api:unit: cd apps/api && uv run pytest -k "not e2e"
